title: Wullf Yularen
description: Wullf Yularen was an Admiral during the Clone Wars, serving gallantly for the Republic alongside Jedi General Anakin Skywalker. As the Republic transitioned to the Empire, Yularen continued in Imperial service, rising up the ranks, rooting out traitors in the Senate and elsewhere in the galaxy. He became a colonel in the ISB and was even assigned to the Death Star.
